periods.time: vol-09 ch-004, minutes before Ikki vs Sara

name.zh: 一辉拒绝与严断绝关系
name.en: Ikki refuses to sever ties with Itsuki

periods.location: Corridor toward the VIP seats and player areas at Wangan Dome
periods.summary: Ikki waits for Itsuki before his match with Sara and rejects the proposed severance, choosing to keep their father-son bond despite irreconcilable ideals.
periods.cause: Sara's story convinces Ikki that even one-sided love toward a flawed parent is valid and that he need not prioritize Itsuki's convenience over his own feelings.
periods.process: Ikki tells Itsuki he refuses to cut ties because he is still Ikki Kurogane. Itsuki unexpectedly asks whether Ikki truly wants a man like him as father, admitting he was raised to embody discipline and cannot cheer for Ikki. Ikki answers that fathers and sons can oppose each other, argue and even fight without ceasing to be family.
periods.outcome: Itsuki accepts the framing as an ordinary father-son quarrel and praises Ikki as having become a great person. Ikki leaves for the match with a clear heart and understands that his name contains Itsuki's wish for him to shine at least once.
periods.aftermath: Ikki enters the Sara match relaxed despite lacking Ittou Shura, determined to show his father the shining self he chose by his own will.
periods.significance: Resolves Ikki's long-standing family burden for this stage of the story and strengthens his resolve for the third round.
